question: Kharchi Puja of Tripura is celebrated in the month of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**July-August**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kharchi Pooja **is a popular Hindu festival that is celebrated in** Tripura**, which is a state in the northeastern part of India.
 
• During this festival,** 14 Hindu Gods** are worshipped, including the Earth.
 
• The festival is celebrated to seek blessings from these deities for the well-being and prosperity of the people of Tripura.
 
• The **festival is usually held in the month of July -August and lasts for seven days.**
 
• **The Kharchi Pooja festival is considered to be one of the most important festivals in Tripura,** and people from all communities and religions participate in it.
 
• The festival is also known for its unique rituals and customs, such as the cleaning of the temple premises, the decoration of the deities, and the offering of various items as part of the pooja.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Tripura **is a state in Northeast India. At 10,491 km², it is the third-smallest state in the union and, with 3.67 million people, the seventh least populated.
 
• Bangladesh borders it to the north, south, and west, and Assam and Mizoram to the east.
 
• Eight districts and twenty-three sub-divisions make up the state of Tripura, whose capital and largest city is Agartala.
 
• There are nineteen distinct tribal communities in Tripura, the bulk of which are Bengali. Three languages are official in the state: Bengali, English, and Kokborok.
